newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Jaya says acquires three feeder vessels.
newsitem.headline: Jaya says acquires three feeder vessels.

text.p: Singapore's Jaya Holdings said on Thursday it has acquired three more feeder ships for containerised and general breakbulk cargoes in Southeast Asia.

The three ships are the MV Jaya Venus, with a capacity of 10,480 deadweight tonnes, the 11,650 deadweight tonne MV Argonaut and the 10,800 deadweight tonne MV Jaya Mars, the company said in a statement.

"The strong container arrangements onboard puts the vessel(s) in an ideal position to capitalise on the trade in the growing Asian economies as well as other under-equipped ports," the statement said.
The latest additions have increased Jaya's fleet to 14 vessels and are expected to provide the company with a steady source of revenue exceeding S$10 million a year.
